'creates_work — true only when a new result not covered by an existing task is being accepted': the row opens fresh here, so true, and 'a fresh row opens for it' with one result means work_items is 1. Nothing was in flight for this idea (it was awaiting the person's word), so attaches_to_existing_work is false. Per the operation ladder, creates_work true — a piece of work accepted now — runs ["T1","T2"]; the queued-only exception does not apply, because the person said go ahead rather than asking to keep it for later. Dimensions and specialists are left empty: the scenario states no content for the thing being built, and 'Naming a dimension claims something in it must change; if nothing in it changes, do not name it', with specialists likewise 'None is mandatory' — naming either on a guess would claim a change this turn gives no grounds for.
